scope.summary: SEC-044 + SEC-045: complete the revocation side of the dark dashboard scoped-session token (dst_). SEC-044 wires revokeAll into PIN rotation. SEC-045 rebuilds DashboardSessionStore for strict refresh-token-rotation reuse detection, tombstone-on-every-live-removal (so revocation resolves via a consumed/expired/evicted token), a per-family cap that contains the offending family, a family-count bound, and public prune() run on a 60s timer; plus a step-up-gated POST /dashboard/session/revoke-all and an SSE per-delivery liveness re-check. All gated by security.dashboardScopedToken.enabled (default false) — byte-identical when off.
